raw_text: A deepfake video purporting to show a prominent Bollywood actor endorsing a PM candidate has been identified as manipulated content by multiple fact-checking organisations. The Election Commission of India has taken cognisance of the matter and directed social media platforms to remove the video. Forensic analysis revealed the clip was created using face-swap AI tools, with the source footage traced to an unrelated 2022 public appearance. Cyber crime cells in two states have registered cases.
clean_text: Deepfake Bollywood endorsement video identified as manipulated. Election Commission directed removal. Source footage traced to 2022 appearance. Cyber crime cases registered in two states.
